P_title: Will the global literacy rate for women reach 95% by 2030?
Q_title: Will female participation in STEM fields increase by 50% by 2030?
R_title: Will either the global literacy rate for women reach 95% or female participation in STEM fields increase by 50% by 2030? Body: Will either of the following occur by December 31, 2030: (a) The literacy rate among women globally attains 95%, as reported by the United Nations and UNESCO? (b) There is a 50% increase in female participation and representation in Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM) fields worldwide, as documented by educational and professional sector reports? Resolution criteria: For (a), the question resolves to YES if the United Nations and UNESCO report that the global literacy rate for women has reached 95% by the specified date. For (b), the question resolves to YES if educational and professional sector reports document a 50% increase in female participation in STEM fields worldwide by the specified date.

P_title: Will the global net-zero carbon emissions goal be achieved by 2050?
Q_title: Will renewable energy sources supply 80% of global energy needs by 2050?
R_title: Will either the global net-zero carbon emissions goal be achieved or renewable energy sources supply 80% of global energy needs by 2050? Body: Will either of the following occur by December 31, 2050: (a) The world collectively achieves net-zero carbon emissions, balancing emitted and absorbed carbon, as confirmed by international climate agreements and environmental monitoring organizations? (b) Renewable energy sources (solar, wind, hydro, etc.) provide 80% of the world's total energy consumption, as reported by the International Energy Agency (IEA)? Resolution criteria: The question will be resolved as "Yes" if either (a) or (b) is confirmed to have occurred by the specified date.

P_title: Will the global average life expectancy exceed 85 years by 2050?
Q_title: Will the incidence of age-related diseases decrease by 30% by 2050?
R_title: Will either the global average life expectancy exceed 85 years or the incidence of age-related diseases decrease by 30% by 2050? Body: Will either of the following occur by December 31, 2050: (a) The global average life expectancy surpasses 85 years, as reported by the World Health Organization (WHO) and international health studies. (b) The global incidence rates of age-related diseases (such as Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, and certain cancers) decline by 30% compared to 2020 levels, as documented by medical research organizations? Resolution criteria: (a) The global average life expectancy must be reported to exceed 85 years by the WHO and international health studies. (b) The global incidence rates of age-related diseases must be documented to have declined by 30% compared to 2020 levels by medical research organizations.
